note: Set B correctly distinguishes between the PV Post Detail (A1) and Crane Attachment Details (A5, C3), accurately attributing dimensions like 2" TYP and 3" TYP to the PV Post base plate, whereas Set A incorrectly attributes these to the Crane Attachment or C3. Set A also contains significant redundancy, extracting the same plate and bolt dimensions multiple times with slight variations, and truncates quotes (e.g., '3/4" D'). Set B has minor errors binding specific plate thicknesses to the wrong detail (assigning C3's 1/2" PL to A5), but its overall component identification is more accurate and faithful to the document structure.
